desc:
crystal pvp on roblox. ffa, duels and practice

⚔️ FFA
12 kits - crystal, sword, axe & shield, mace, spear, pots, tnt cart, redstone traps, smp, uhc and more
crits, shields, totems, pearls, anchors and wind charges all work like you'd expect

🤖 PRACTICE
fight bots (easy to impossible) or dummies on your own land

🥊 DUELS
1v1 anyone in your server

🗺️ MAPS
8 maps, new one every 15 mins

🎁 SKINS
get coins from kills, open crates, 191 skins to collect

🔧 CUSTOM KITS
get 50 kills to make and name your own kits

works on pc, mobile and console (controller supported)

not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft or DonutSMP
